name: Firebolt
effectText: You shoot a blast of fire towards an enemy within range. Make a Spell Attack defended by Agility. On hit: 1[CD] Piercing damage.

name: Fireball
effectText: You launch a bead of condensed fire at a spot within range, which creates a Blast 2 explosion of fire. Make a Spell Attack defended by Agility for all Characters within the Area. On hit: 2[CD] Piercing damage.

name: Meteor
effectText: You launch an orb of explosive fire from the sky, striking a spot within range, which creates a Blast 2 explosion of fire. Make a Spell Attack defended by Agility for all Characters within the Area. On hit: 3[CD] Piercing Damage.

name: Frigid Grasp
effectText: You shoot a wave of frigid cold towards an enemy within range. Make a Spell Attack defended by Brawn. On hit: 1[CD] Piercing damage, target is Slowed until the end of their next turn.

name: Blizzard
effectText: You send a wave of magickal cold out in a size 3 Cone originating from yourself. Make a Spell Attack defended by Brawn for all Characters within the Area. On hit: 1[CD] Piercing damage, target is Slowed until the end of their next turn.

name: Fimbulvetr
effectText: You send a devastating torrent of freezing energy out in a size 4 Cone originating from yourself. Make a Spell Attack defended by Brawn for all Characters within the Area. On hit: 2[CD] Piercing damage, target is Slowed until the end of their next turn.

name: Electric Arc
effectText: You shoot an arc of lightning towards an enemy within range. Make a Spell Attack defended by Coordination. On hit: 1[CD] Piercing damage, and target is Off-Guard until the end of their next turn.

name: Voltaic Javelin
effectText: You shoot a 5 long Line of crackling lightning out from yourself. Make a Spell Attack defended by Coordination for all Characters within the Area. On hit: 1[CD] Piercing damage, target is Off-Guard until the end of their next turn.

name: Lightning Bolt
effectText: You shoot a 10 long Line of thunderous lightning out from yourself. Make a Spell Attack defended by Coordination for all Characters within the Area. On hit: 2[CD] Piercing damage, and target is Off-Guard until the end of their next turn.

name: Armis Arcane
effectText: As long as you have this spell prepared, you have 2 Resistance while unarmored.

name: Arcane Parry
effectText: When defending against an attack, you can cast this spell to use Magick in place of Agility, Brawn, Coordination, and Awareness.

name: Invisibilis
effectText: You become Invisible until the end of your next turn, or until you make an Attack (the Invisibility ends after the attack is made).

name: Major Invisibilis
effectText: As a Minor Action, you become Invisible until the end of your next turn.

name: Skip
effectText: Teleport up to a number of spaces equal to Half your Magick.

name: Arcane Leap
effectText: Teleport up to a number of spaces equal to your Magick.

name: Redisplacement
effectText: You attempt to shift the location of another Character within range. Make a Magick + Study task, Difficulty 1 if the target Character is willing, or opposed by Presence + Study if the target is unwilling. On a success, the target teleports up to a number of spaces equal to your Magick to a space of your choice that you can see.

name: Arcane Jaunt
effectText: Teleport up to a number of spaces equal to your Magick. One Ally of your choice within Reach may Teleport with you, Teleporting to a space within Reach of where you finish your teleportation.

name: Volcanic Strike
effectText: You imbue your weapon with fire. The damage of your next Attack with a Melee Weapon increases by 1[CD] and gains Burst 1.

name: Frozen Strike
effectText: You imbue your weapon with frost. The damage of your next Attack with a Melee Weapon increases by 1[CD] and on a successful hit the Target is Slowed until the end of their next turn.

name: Thunderous Strike
effectText: You imbue your weapon with lightning. The damage of your next Attack with a Melee Weapon increases by 1[CD] and on a successful hit the Target is Off-Guard until the end of their next turn.
